name: _sparse_compressed_tensor_with_dims
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim from the supplied registered schema: aten::_sparse_compressed_tensor_with_dims(int nnz, int dense_dim, int[] size, int[] blocksize, ScalarType index_dtype, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=False) -> Tensor. This representative overload is not exclusive and does not bound the operator: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract, defining all registered overloads, keyword arguments, defaults, returns, error behavior, aliasing and mutation, so no test may be removed or narrowed and no reference behavior may be adapted to fit this one signature. All supplied registered schemas (verbatim): aten::_sparse_compressed_tensor_with_dims(int nnz, int dense_dim, int[] size, int[] blocksize, ScalarType index_dtype, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=False) -> Tensor. Semantics from the tests: an allocation factory that creates an uninitialized compressed sparse tensor with the requested structure and returns it; it takes no tensor operand. The five positional arguments give the stored-entry count nnz, the number of dense tail dims dense_dim, the logical shape size (at least rank 2, carrying the sparse dims; leading batch dims allowed), the block shape blocksize (block layouts only, otherwise empty and rejected on CSR/CSC) and the index ScalarType index_dtype (Int/Long only; Int16/Int8/Bool/Float are rejected). The returned tensor must have the requested layout (one of CSR, CSC, BSR, BSC; sparse_coo and strided are rejected), logical shape size, dense_dim(), _nnz equal to nnz on data-backed devices, and three independent storages (compressed indices, other indices, values) whose part shapes follow the layout and whose values part has the requested dtype and is contiguous; the index parts take index_dtype. Every part must be writable, and a written allocation must densify identically to the reference, so the parts are separate allocations rather than views. The allocation is created on the requested device, including meta (where the nnz read is not meaningful), and CPU allocations honor pin_memory for all three parts. Non-JSON ATen defaults were rendered as stable strings and are retained here as-is: ScalarType? dtype=None becomes JSON null, Layout? layout=None becomes JSON null, Device? device=None becomes JSON null, and bool? pin_memory=False becomes JSON false, matching the schema-declared optional keyword-only metadata. The schema lists layout as optional with default null, but the tests treat it as effectively required and check that omitting it raises RuntimeError; that error behavior stays in pytest. Error handling for negative/fractional/NaN/Inf nnz, negative or out-of-range dense_dim, size rank 0/1 or non-integer entries, invalid blocksize length or non-divisor blocksize, unsupported layouts, unsupported index dtypes, and non-CPU pinning remains entirely owned by the original pytest and is not expressed by this single-overload model.
